scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hey, Taekwon Boy!
Come here for a minute.
I've got a proposition
for you if you'll listen!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嘿，跆拳小子！
过来一下。
如果你愿意听的话，
我有个提议给你！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hey, Taekwon Girl!
Come here for a minute.
I've got a proposition
for you if you'll listen!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嘿，跆拳少女！
过来一下。
如果你愿意听的话，
我有个提议给你！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Alright, kid.
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
好吧，小孩。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Geez, you're so direct.
A little warmth, a little
friendliness wouldn't kill
you, now would it? Anyway,
have you given any thought
as to what you want to be?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
哎呀，你还真直接。
稍微热情一点，友好一点
又不会要了你的命，对吧？
总之，你有没有想过
将来想成为什么样的人？

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
If your heart isn't already
set on it, why don't you become
a ^4D4DFFwarrior of the Sun, the Moon,^FFFFFF ^4D4DFF and the Stars^000000? Just consider it.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
如果你心里还没有定论，
要不要考虑成为^4D4DFF太阳、月亮和星星^FFFFFF ^4D4DFF的战士^000000呢？
好好考虑一下吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Warrior of the wha--?
I've never heard of that
job. But I do know I can
change jobs to a Soul
Linker or Taekwon Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么什么的战士——？
我没听说过这个职业。
但我知道我可以转职成
悟灵士或者跆拳道大师。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Yeah. Yeah, that's right.
Taekwon Masters are warriors
of the Sun, Moon, and Stars, and wield the power of the cosmos!
Cool, huh? Anyway, interested
in being a Taekwon Master?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
是啊。没错。
跆拳道大师就是太阳、
月亮和星星的战士，
掌握着宇宙的力量！
很酷吧？总之，有兴趣
成为跆拳道大师吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am!
scripts.translation: 是的，我有兴趣！

scripts.text: No, not so much.
scripts.translation: 不，没什么兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Great, great~ I knew you'd
see things my way. Alright,
you seem to be ready enough.
All you need now is someone
who can train you to become
a Taekwon Master.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
太好了，太好了~
我就知道你会认同我的想法。
好吧，你看起来已经准备好了。
现在你只需要一个能训练你
成为跆拳道大师的人。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Would you like to ^4D4dffchange
your job to Taekwon Master^000000?
If you do, I'll introduce you to somebody who can help
you accomplish that goal.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
你想^4D4dff转职成为跆拳道大师^000000吗？
如果想的话，我会介绍你
去见一个能帮你实现
这个目标的人。

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有。

scripts.text: Let me think about it...
scripts.translation: 让我再想想……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Excellent! Now, as you may
have guessed, Taekwon Masters
aren't organized into an official guild. So it's tough for all of us
to gather, but we also have fewer rules and greater freedom.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
太棒了！正如你可能猜到的，
跆拳道大师并没有组成
正式的公会。所以我们大家
很难聚在一起，但我们也
拥有更少的规矩和更大的自由。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Who's around now...? Umm...
Ah, you should visit ^4D4DFFMoogang^000000.
He's one of the few Taekwon
Masters interested in receiving
new students, so he'll be sure
to guide you in your training.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
现在谁有空呢……？嗯……
啊，你应该去拜访^4D4DFF穆刚^000000。
他是少数几个有兴趣招收
新学生的跆拳道大师之一，
所以他肯定会指导你的训练。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Alright, you can find Moogang
in Comodo, supposedly at the
place that's closest to the sky. In the meantime, I'll write a
letter of recommendation that
I'll send to him for you.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
好吧，你可以在克魔岛找到穆刚，
据说是在离天空最近的地方。
同时，我会写一封推荐信
寄给他。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
That's fine. Changing your
job is an important decision,
so you should consider everything carefully. But let me assure you
that you'll never regret becoming an awesome warrior of the cosmos!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
没关系。转职是一个重要的决定，
所以你应该仔细考虑一切。
但我向你保证，成为一名
了不起的宇宙战士绝不会让你后悔！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Great, great~
But first,you
gotta be at least Job Level 40
before you can begin Taekwon
Master training. Otherwise, 
it'll go over your head.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
太好了，太好了~
但是首先，你
必须至少达到职业等级40级
才能开始跆拳道大师的训练。
否则，你会听不懂的。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
I know you can do it,
and it shouldn't take
too long. Promise me
you'll come back so that
I can help you become
a great Taekwon Master~
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
我知道你能做到的，
而且应该不会花太久时间。
答应我你会回来，
这样我就能帮你成为
一名伟大的跆拳道大师~

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Really? Well, I still
think you're better suited
to being a Taekwon Master
than a Soul Linker. But the
decision is ultimately yours.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
真的吗？嗯，我还是觉得
比起悟灵士，你更适合
成为跆拳道大师。
但最终的决定权在你。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Well, if you change your
mind, just come back to
me and let me know. I know
you'd make a great Taekwon
Master if you really tried.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
好吧，如果你改变主意，
就回来告诉我。
我知道如果你真的努力，
你会成为一名出色的
跆拳道大师。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Aw, don't be like that.
It doesn't cost you a zeny
to listen to my spiel. Come
on, just hear me out...
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
哎，别这样嘛。
听听我的推销又不花你
一个泽尼。来吧，
就听我说说……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
I've already sent him my
letter of recommendation
for you, so go ahead and
visit Moogang in Comodo.
He'll start training you to
become a Taekwon Master.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
我已经把我的
推荐信寄给他了，
所以你去克魔岛拜访穆刚吧。
他会开始训练你
成为跆拳道大师。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
So how's the testing
coming along? Oh hey, you
look worried. Are you in
some kind of trouble?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
那么测试进展如何？
哦嘿，你看起来有点担心。
你是遇到什么麻烦了吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm fine.
scripts.translation: 不，我没事。

scripts.text: About Beeryu's riddle...
scripts.translation: 关于比尔尤的谜题……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
It's alright to be independent
and solve problems on your
own, but you should elicit help
when you really need it. There
is no shame in being unable to
accomplish something alone...
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
独立解决问题是好事，
但在真正需要帮助时应该寻求帮助。
独自无法完成某事并不可耻……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Ah, that. Beeryu has
given you that riddle
to solve. Well, first of
all, you have to bring him
something very important,
but it isn't a material object.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
啊，那个。比尔尤给了你
一个谜题去解。嗯，首先，
你必须带给他非常重要的东西，
但它不是物质上的物品。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
You have to demonstrate
something for him. Now tell
me, when you face difficulty in
life, obstacles to your goals,
how do you respond? What
does your heart feel, man?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
你必须向他展示某种东西。
现在告诉我，当你在生活中
遇到困难，阻碍你达成目标时，
你会如何应对？你的内心感受如何，伙计？

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
I know that Beeryu asked you
to prove your patience to him,
but this is the most important
factor behind patience. What
do you say to yourself when
your life seems hopeless?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
我知道比尔尤让你向他证明
你的耐心，但这正是耐心背后
最重要的因素。当你的生活看似
绝望时，你对自己说什么？

scripts.text: I will not give up!
scripts.translation: 我不会放弃！

scripts.text: I... I don't know?
scripts.translation: 我……我不知道？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will not give up!
I'll make my dreams
come true, no matter
how long it may take!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不会放弃！
无论需要多长时间，
我都会让我的梦想成真！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Yes, that's it!
When your resolution
is backed by an iron will,
you will have the patience
to weather out all things.
Show Beeryu your resolve...
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
对，就是这样！
当你的决心有钢铁般的意志支撑时，
你就有耐心度过一切风雨。
向比尔尤展示你的决心吧……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Great, I think you're
ready now. Please go
talk to Moogang and head
back to the Moon Room. Soon,
maybe we'll be able to greet
each other as Taekwon Masters!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
太好了，我想你现在准备好了。
请去和穆刚谈谈，然后回到月亮房间。
很快，也许我们就能以
跆拳道大师的身份互相问候了！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
You... You don't know?
If you'd face obstacles
head on and directly confront
your fears, your enemies, and
all of life's challenges, then the answer should come naturally.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
你……你不知道？
如果你直面障碍，直接面对
你的恐惧、敌人以及生活中的所有挑战，
那么答案自然会浮现。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hmm...
Why don't you contemplate
the value of courage for
a little while? Yes, that
might be useful for now.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嗯……
你不妨思考一下勇气的价值
一会儿？是的，那可能对你现在有用。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Great, I think you're
ready now. Please go
talk to Moogang and head
back to the Moon Room. Soon,
maybe we'll be able to greet
each other as Taekwon Masters!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
太好了，我想你现在准备好了。
请去和穆刚谈谈，然后回到月亮房间。
很快，也许我们就能以
跆拳道大师的身份互相问候了！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
So, how have you
been doing? I got
faith that you'll become
a great Taekwon Master, so
I'm expecting great things.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
那么，你最近过得怎么样？
我相信你会成为一名伟大的
跆拳道大师，所以我对你寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hey, how have you
been doing? Attuned
with nature and all
that, I see. Heh heh,
isn't the cosmos such
a wonderful thing?
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嘿，你最近过得怎么样？
看来你已经与自然融为一体了。
嘿嘿，宇宙不是很美妙吗？

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hey, kid. Do you want
to learn Taekwon Do?
If you learn it, then you're
guaranteed to become
much stronger!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嘿，小孩。你想学跆拳道吗？
如果你学了，保证你会变得
更强！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Let's see...
There's a man named
Phoenix who can teach
you Taekwon Do. He's
around here somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
让我看看……
有个叫凤凰的人可以教你
跆拳道。他就在附近某个地方……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Anyway, once you've
learned Taekwon Do for
a while, go ahead and come
back to me if you really want to advance your studies, to master
more than your mind and body.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
总之，当你练了一段时间跆拳道后，
如果你真的想深造，超越身心，
就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Dude...
Whaddya want?
You wanna join up
with my martial arts
school? It's too late
for you, sorry pal~
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
兄弟……
你想要什么？
你想加入我的武术学校吗？
对你来说太晚了，抱歉伙计~

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Dude...
Whaddya want?
Oh, I didn't realize tha--
Y-you're such a beautiful
lady! I guess I oughta, you
know, apologize for bein' rude.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
兄弟……
你想要什么？
哦，我没意识到那——
你-你真是一位美丽的女士！
我想我应该，你知道，为我的无礼道歉。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Anyway, if you think I'm
just some punk, I'll admit
that I look and act the part.
But actually, I'm a warrior of
the Sun, Moon, and Stars.
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
总之，如果你觉得我只是个混混，
我承认我看起来和表现得都像。
但实际上，我是太阳、月亮和星星的战士。

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
It might be a little late
for you, but if you know 
anybody that wants to become
a Taekwon Master, send them
my way. I'll make sure that
they meet the right people~
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
对你来说可能有点晚了，
但如果你认识任何想成为
跆拳道大师的人，把他们引荐给我。
我会确保他们遇到合适的人~

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Hm...? Oh, you're just
the kind of person I'm
looking for. Come, I've
got an offer for you if
you're willing to listen...
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
嗯……？哦，你正是我在找的那种人。
来，如果你愿意听，
我有个提议给你……

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
How's it going, warrior?
Please continue to use
your skills for the right
causes. Bring pride to all
Taekwon Masters everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
进展如何，战士？
请继续将你的技能用于正义的事业。
为所有的跆拳道大师带来荣耀！

scripts.text:
[Moohyun]
Whoa, whoa~
Step aside, will you?
You're blocking my sun!
scripts.translation:
[武铉]
哇，哇~
让开点好吗？
你挡住我的阳光了！

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
{0}...
I have been expecting you.
Moohyun has told me about
your arrival and your desire
to become a Taekwon Master.
I will trust his judgment...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
{0}……
我一直在等你。
武铉告诉了我你的到来
以及你想成为跆拳道大师的愿望。
我会相信他的判断……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Yes, Moohyun is skilled at
discerning the inner strengths
of others. You should do well.
Are you ready for the first test, to use your fists and legs in the
service of the grand cosmos?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
是的，武铉擅长洞察他人的内在力量。
你应该会做得很好。
你准备好接受第一个测试了吗？
用你的拳头和腿为宏大的宇宙服务？

scripts.text: Yes, let me take the test!
scripts.translation: 是的，让我接受测试！

scripts.text: Wait, I need to think about this!
scripts.translation: 等等，我需要想想！

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Hm? You still have Skill
Points that you haven't yet
allocated. Use them, learn
and improve your Taekwon Girl
skills. When you are finished, come back here for your training.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯？你还有未分配的技能点数。
使用它们，学习并提升你的
跆拳少女技能。完成后，
回来这里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Hm? You still have Skill
Points that you haven't yet
allocated. Use them, learn
and improve your Taekwon Boy
skills. When you are finished, come back here for your training.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯？你还有未分配的技能点数。
使用它们，学习并提升你的
跆拳小子技能。完成后，
回来这里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Taekwon Do sets the basics.
Mind, body, soul. These are not
separate parts, but a functioning whole. Your self is in touch
with itself, but is it in touch
with the outside world?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
跆拳道奠定基础。
心、身、魂。这些不是分离的部分，
而是一个运作的整体。
你的自我与自身相连，
但它与外部世界相连吗？

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Close your eyes. Seek out
the sensation of the wind.
Open your arms and embrace
the sky. Can you feel it? The
everspreading flow of the
universal cosmos?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
闭上眼睛。寻找风的感觉。
张开双臂拥抱天空。你能感觉到吗？
那不断扩展的宇宙洪流？

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Nature's laws cannot be broken,
but as your undestanding of nature grows, you'll be able to grasp the
sunlight, hold the moonlight, and mold the starlight. This test will
help you attune yourself...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
自然法则不可打破，
但随着你对自然理解的加深，
你将能抓住阳光，握住月光，
塑造星光。这个测试将帮助你调整自己……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Go forth and gather the
power of nature scattered
around the world. Bring me
pieces of the blustery wind,
solid earth, freezing ice,
and burning flame.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
前去收集散落在世界各地的
自然之力。给我带来狂风、
大地、寒冰和烈焰的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
In other words...
^4D4DFFRough Wind^000000,
^4D4DFFGreat Nature^000000,
^4D4DFFMystic Frozen^000000 and
^4D4DFFFlame Heart^000000.
Now go...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
换句话说……
^4D4DFF风灵原石^000000、
^4D4DFF土灵原石^000000、
^4D4DFF水灵原石^000000和
^4D4DFF火灵原石^000000。
现在去吧……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
I respect your decision,
although I see no reason
for you to hesitate. But like
the phases of the moon, all
changes must occur according
to the grand scheme of things.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我尊重你的决定，
虽然我看不到你犹豫的理由。
但就像月相一样，所有的变化
都必须按照宏大的计划发生。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, you've completed the
task I've set for you. Very
good. Now, while holding these
shards of the wind, earth, ice
and flame, did you sense the
connection between them all?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，你已经完成了我交给你的任务。
很好。现在，握着这些风、土、冰
和火的碎片时，你感受到它们之间
的联系了吗？

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Winds provide gentle and
comforting breezes or bring
destructive hurricanes. Earth
is the solid ground on which
all life lives, but it can also
sink and shake buildings.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
风带来温柔舒适的微风，
或带来毁灭飓风。大地是所有生命
赖以生存的坚实土地，但它也能
使建筑物下沉和震动。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Water gives life and provides
cooling refreshment, but it can
also drown and freeze life. Fire can bring comforting warmth,
but it can also reduce life to
gray ashes. Such is nature.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
水赋予生命并提供清凉的 refreshment，
但也能淹死和冻结生命。火能带来
舒适的温暖，但也能将生命化为灰烬。
这就是自然。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
This is the power of nature.
Any force can be used to do
good or evil, depending on
how you wield it. So do you
understand now? This is how
the universe is intertwined.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
这就是自然的力量。
任何力量都可以用来行善或作恶，
取决于你如何使用它。所以你现在明白了吗？
这就是宇宙交织的方式。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
However, the most primal,
the purest elements of our
universe are equated to the
cosmos: the Sun, the Moon,
and the Stars. Contemplate
on this truth for a while...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
然而，我们宇宙中最原始、
最纯粹的元素等同于宇宙：
太阳、月亮和星星。
暂时思考一下这个真理……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
With the realization of
the nature of the universe
comes the respect for nature
and all things. Now, when you
are ready for the next test, then
I shall guide you to the altar.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
认识到宇宙的本质后，
就会对自然和万物产生敬畏。
现在，当你准备好进行下一个测试时，
我将引导你去祭坛。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
For your first test on your
journey towards becoming
a Taekwon Master, bring me 
shards of the natural elements.
I want you to understand their innate harmony with one another.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
在你成为跆拳道大师的旅程中，
作为第一个测试，给我带来
自然元素的碎片。
我希望你理解它们之间固有的和谐。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Bring...
^4D4DFFRough Wind^000000,
^4D4DFFGreat Nature^000000,
^4D4DFFMystic Frozen^000000 and
^4D4DFFFlame Heart^000000.
Now go...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
带来……
^4D4DFF风灵原石^000000、
^4D4DFF土灵原石^000000、
^4D4DFF水灵原石^000000和
^4D4DFF火灵原石^000000。
现在去吧……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Are you ready for
the next test to become
a Taekwon Master? Then,
I shall guide you to the altar.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
你准备好接受成为
跆拳道大师的下一个测试了吗？
那么，我将引导你去祭坛。

scripts.text: Wait, I need more time!
scripts.translation: 等等，我需要更多时间！

scripts.text: Yes, I am ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
I see. Well then, please
let me know when you
are ready to proceed.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我明白了。那么，
请在你准备好继续时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
At the altar, speak
to Daru, who will serve
as your guide for that
test. After you complete
the test, come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
在祭坛，与达鲁交谈，
他将作为你那次测试的向导。
完成测试后，回来和我谈话。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
How very strange...
You cannot have completed
that test by now. Ah, something
must have happened. I shall
send you back to the altar
so that Daru can test you.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
真奇怪……
你现在不可能已经完成那个测试了。
啊，一定发生了什么事。
我会送你回祭坛，
让达鲁测试你。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Hmm...
You seem troubled.
Ah, you must be thinking
about Beeryu's riddle, yes?
You are the only one that
can find the answer...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯……
你看起来有心事。
啊，你一定是在想比尔尤的谜题，对吧？
只有你能找到答案……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Hmm. Perhaps it would
be best for you to consult
with ^4D4DFFMoohyun^000000 back in Payon
so that you may understand
Beeryu's test regarding the
value of patience.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯。也许最好你去斐扬咨询^4D4DFF武铉^000000，
以便你理解比尔尤关于
耐心价值的测试。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Once you discover the
meaning of patience that
Beeryu wants you to find,
come back to me so that
I can send you back to the
Moon Room for testing.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
一旦你发现了比尔尤希望你找到的
耐心的含义，就回来找我，
这样我就能送你回月亮房间进行测试。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, I see that Moohyun
has helped you achieve a
new level of understanding.
Very well, very well. Let me
send you to the Moon Room
where Beeryu is waiting...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，我看到武铉帮助你达到了
新的理解层次。
很好，很好。让我送你去月亮房间，
比尔尤在那里等着……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Would you like to
return to the Star Room
to complete your Taekwon
Master testing and training?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
你想回到星星房间
完成你的跆拳道大师测试和训练吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Don't lose heart...
I expect that you will
achieve your goal of
becoming a Taekwon
Master very soon.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
不要灰心……
我预计你很快就会实现
成为跆拳道大师的目标。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
I see. Well, when
your mind, body and
spirit are prepared, please
come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我明白了。好吧，当你的
心、身、灵都准备好时，
请再来和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, you have come here in
order to speak to Cheehee.
Would you like me to send
you to the Star Room now?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，你来这里是为了和奇希说话。
你想让我现在送你去星星房间吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Don't lose heart...
I expect that you will
achieve your goal of
becoming a Taekwon
Master very soon.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
不要灰心……
我预计你很快就会实现
成为跆拳道大师的目标。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
I see. Well, when
your mind, body and
spirit are prepared, please
come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我明白了。好吧，当你的
心、身、灵都准备好时，
请再来和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, you've returned
wiser and more attuned
with nature than before.
Yes, I can see it in your eyes.
So tell me, what did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，你回来了，比之前更智慧，
与自然更融合。
是的，我从你的眼中看出来了。
告诉我，你学到了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can feel the bond between
the Sun, the Moon and the
Stars. They all give light,
but their different shades
bestow different gifts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我能感受到太阳、月亮和星星之间的联系。
它们都发出光芒，
但不同的色调赋予不同的礼物。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The sun gives glorious
warmth and is the wellspring
of life. Moonlight is gentle and gives comfort. The twinkling
of stars gives hope in even
the darkest of nights.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太阳给予光荣的温暖，是生命的源泉。
月光温柔，给予安慰。
即使在最黑暗的夜晚，
星星的闪烁也给予希望。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I also know the Sun's
scorching, destructive
heat, the loneliness of
the Moon, and the sadness
of the Stars. I now understand
the spectrum of the cosmos!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也知道太阳灼热的破坏性热量，
月亮的孤独，以及星星的悲伤。
我现在理解了宇宙的谱系！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The combined rage of the
cosmos can summon a 
demon of utter darkness.
The combined love of the
cosmos bestows infinite
blessing and light...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
宇宙的combined rage可以召唤出
完全黑暗的恶魔。
宇宙的combined love赋予无限的
祝福和光明……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
I cannot ask for
anything more. You
are already a warrior
of the Sun, the Moon and
the Stars. Welcome to our
way of martial arts, friend.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我不要求更多了。
你已经是太阳、月亮和星星的战士了。
欢迎加入我们的武术之道，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
From now on, please
make your decisions very
carefully. What you decide
will determine the course
of your entire life. Also,
never forget this song...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
从现在开始，请非常谨慎地做出决定。
你的决定将决定你一生的道路。
另外，永远不要忘记这首歌……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
''^4D4DFFThe Sun shines on even days.
The Moon gleams on odd days.
The Stars sparkle on every
fifth day without fail.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
''^4D4DFF双日太阳照。
单日月亮耀。
每五日星辰闪，
从不缺席。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
That is all that I can
share with you. Never forget
that we, as Taekwon Masters,
cannot exist separately from
the Sun, Moon and Stars...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
这就是我能与你分享的一切。
永远不要忘记，作为跆拳道大师，
我们不能脱离太阳、月亮和星星而存在……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Oh, hello. You're a
student of Taekwon Do,
are you not? It's nice to
meet you. Please call
me Moogang. I too used to
study this Tae Kwon Do.
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
哦，你好。你是跆拳道的学生，
不是吗？很高兴见到你。
请叫我穆刚。我也曾学习过跆拳道。

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Um...
Have you ever
considered becoming...
Um... No. Wait. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯……
你有没有考虑过成为……
嗯……不。等等。嗯……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Oh, dear! I always
have a little bit of
trouble speaking to other
people. Now, why don't
you speak to my good
friend, Moohyun?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
哦，天哪！我总是有点
难以与他人交谈。
现在，你为什么不和我的好朋友
武铉谈谈呢？

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
It's just...
I'm so excited!
There's every chance
that you might possibly
be the warrior I'm seeking!
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
只是……
我太兴奋了！
你很有可能是我正在寻找的战士！

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Oh, it's very nice to
see you again. So where
have you been lately? I trust
that you've been to places
blessed by the Sun, Moon
and Stars, correct?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
哦，很高兴再次见到你。
那么你最近去了哪里？
我相信你去了受太阳、月亮
和星星祝福的地方，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
My friend, please keep
my advice in mind and 
always be careful when
you make decisions. I don't
want to see you regreting your decision later on in your life...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
我的朋友，请记住我的建议，
做决定时要小心。
我不想看到你日后后悔自己的决定……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, if you miss the
Room of the Sun, the
Moon Room or the Star Room,
I can send you there anytime
that you wish. Would you like
to visit any of them now?
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，如果你想念太阳房间、
月亮房间或星星房间，
我可以随时送你去那里。
你现在想去其中任何一个吗？

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text: To the Room of the Sun!
scripts.translation: 去太阳房间！

scripts.text: To the Moon Room!
scripts.translation: 去月亮房间！

scripts.text: To the Star Room!
scripts.translation: 去星星房间！

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Alright. I'll always be
here, so whenever you
feel like going to any of
those places, just come
and talk to me. Goodbye
for now, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
好吧。我会一直在这里，
所以无论何时你想去那些地方，
就来和我谈谈。再见，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, you must miss
the glorious warmth
of the sun, eh? Let
me send you there
right away...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，你一定想念太阳的光荣温暖，
是吧？让我马上送你去那里……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Hm? Have you need
of the soothing light of
the Moon? Then I hope
that you find peace in
its calming influence...
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
嗯？你需要月亮的柔和光芒吗？
那么我希望你在其平静的影响下
找到安宁……

scripts.text:
[Moogang]
Ah, there are countless
reasons as to why you'd want
to view the twinkling of the
stars. Well, let me send you
to the Star Room right away~
scripts.translation:
[穆刚]
啊，想看星星闪烁的理由有无数种。
好吧，让我马上送你去星星房间~

scripts.text:
[Wandering Martial Artist]
Do you enjoy hiking?
The fresh air, the liberation
found in wandering, and the
beauty of natural are all
welcome benefits.
scripts.translation:
[游历的武术家]
你喜欢徒步旅行吗？
新鲜的空气，流浪中的解放感，
以及自然之美都是受欢迎的益处。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Martial Artist]
Of course, I cannot enjoy
the moonlight and starlight
on nighttime hikes as much
as you can. Well then, may the
Sun, Moon and Stars protect
you on all your journeys~
scripts.translation:
[游历的武术家]
当然，我无法像你一样享受夜间徒步时的
月光和星光。那么，愿太阳、月亮和星星
在你所有的旅程中保护你~

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Ah, greetings.
I am Daru, and I will
be your guide for this room.
For this test, you must open
your eyes and answer my
questions. Let us begin.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
啊，问候。
我是达鲁，将是这个房间的向导。
对于这个测试，你必须睁开眼睛
回答我的问题。让我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Tell me.
What is it
that you see?
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
告诉我。
你看到了什么？

scripts.text: The Sun.
scripts.translation: 太阳。

scripts.text: The Moon.
scripts.translation: 月亮。

scripts.text: The Stars.
scripts.translation: 星星。

scripts.text: I have no idea.
scripts.translation: 我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Yes! It is the sun!
I suppose you can think
of mankind as the sons of
the sun. Good, very good...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
是的！是太阳！
我想你可以把人类看作太阳之子。
好，非常好……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
The... The moon?
Mm. But this is the
Sun Room. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
……月亮？
嗯。但这里是太阳房间。嗯……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
The Stars. Well, hmm.
I suppose you can think of
the Sun as one of thousands
of stars in the universe...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
星星。嗯，好吧。
我想你可以把太阳看作宇宙中
成千上万颗星星中的一颗……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
No... idea?
Hmm. You should
open your mind as
well as your eyes.
It wouldn't hurt to
try to guess an answer...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
没……主意？
嗯。你应该打开心扉，
也要睁开眼睛。
试着猜一个答案也无妨……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Now, there is nothing
that can live without the
sun. Do you know what one
needs most from the sun?
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
现在，没有太阳就没有生物能生存。
你知道从太阳那里最需要的是什么吗？

scripts.text: Warmth
scripts.translation: 温暖

scripts.text: Comfort
scripts.translation: 舒适

scripts.text: Light
scripts.translation: 光明

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 无

scripts.text:
[Daru]
That is right.
Without the warmth
of the sun, our world
not only be cold, but it
would be completely lifeless.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
没错。
没有太阳的温暖，我们的世界
不仅寒冷，而且将完全没有生命。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Comfort...?
Ah, yes. The warmth
of the sun brings comfort.
And without comfort, is life
truly worth living? Good answer.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
舒适……？
啊，是的。太阳的温暖带来舒适。
而没有舒适，生活真的值得过吗？
很好的回答。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Yes. Without the
glorious light of the sun,
we would see nothing.
We would know nothing.
We would be nothing.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
是的。没有太阳的光荣光芒，
我们将什么都看不见。
我们将一无所知。
我们将一无所有。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Mmm...
The answer should
come from your heart,
rather than your mind.
Everyone needs something
from the sun. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯……
答案应该来自你的内心，
而不是你的头脑。
每个人都需要从太阳那里得到一些东西。
让我们看看……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
There is a song that goes,
''^4D4DFFThe Sun shines on even days.
The Moon gleams on odd days.
The Stars sparkle on every
fifth day without fail.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
有一首歌是这样唱的，
''^4D4DFF双日太阳照。
单日月亮耀。
每五日星辰闪，
从不缺席。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Daru]
''^4D4DFFA desert is a Solar place,
its sands kissed by the Sun.
A marsh is a Lunar place,
its wolves driven by the Moon.
A deep cave is a Stellar place, its knights enchanted by Stars.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
''^4D4DFF沙漠是太阳之地，
沙粒被太阳亲吻。
沼泽是月亮之地，
狼群被月亮驱使。
深洞是星星之地，骑士被星星迷住。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Now, which of the
following combinations
shines brightest among 
them all? Think carefully...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
现在，以下哪个组合
在其中最耀眼？仔细思考……

scripts.text: 2nd, Marsh, Knights
scripts.translation: 第2天，沼泽，骑士

scripts.text: 4th, Desert, Sand
scripts.translation: 第4天，沙漠，沙子

scripts.text: 10th, Desert, Knights
scripts.translation: 第10天，沙漠，骑士

scripts.text: 5th, Deep Cave, Wolves
scripts.translation: 第5天，深洞，狼

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Well, that will be all.
I cannot possibly know all
there is to know about you
through just 3 questions...
But this should suit our
purposes for now.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
好吧，就到这里。
我不可能仅通过3个问题就了解你的一切……
但这目前应该符合我们的目的。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
I admit that I am impressed
with your understanding of
the Sun. It is the source of
all life, the origin of warmth
and comfort. Now, let me lead
you to the Moon Room.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
我承认我对你的太阳理解印象深刻。
它是所有生命的源泉，温暖和舒适的起源。
现在，让我带你去月亮房间。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Although your understanding
of the Sun is not perfect, you
seem to understand the idea
that it is the source of warm
and life in our world.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
虽然你对太阳的理解并不完美，
但你似乎理解它是我们要世界中
温暖和生命源泉的概念。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
This idea is one of the basics
that will help you in becoming
more attuned with the power of
the cosmos. Now, please come
this way to the Moon Room...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
这个概念是帮助你更好地与宇宙力量
融合的基础之一。现在，请这边走去月亮房间……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hmm... If you do not
understand the role of the
sun in the universe and
the human world, you will
forever be out of touch with
nature, with the cosmos.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯……如果你不理解太阳在宇宙和
人类世界中的作用，你将永远与自然、
与宇宙脱节。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
I advise you to meditate
carefully on the fundamental
truths of nature before coming
to speak to me once again.
Contemplate the infinite
power of the sun...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
我建议你在再次与我交谈之前，
仔细冥想自然的根本真理。
沉思太阳的无限力量……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
There is no longer any
need for us to remain
here. Let us proceed to
the Moon Room together.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
我们不再需要留在这里了。
让我们一起去月亮房间吧。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hmmm. I believe you've
spent enough time reflecting
on the glory of the Sun and
its importance to the humans
and the world. Well done. Now,
let's proceed to the Moon Room.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯。我相信你已经花了足够的时间反思
太阳的荣耀及其对人类和世界的重要性。
做得好。现在，让我们去月亮房间。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Relax every muscle in
your body. Close your eyes.
Feel the warmth of the Sun
against your eyelids as you
meditate on its role in the world and your place in the cosmos.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
放松身体的每一块肌肉。闭上眼睛。
感受阳光照在眼睑上的温暖，
冥想它在世界中的作用以及你在宇宙中的位置。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hm? The time for you
to be in the Room of the
Sun has passed. Let us go
to the Star Room now...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯？你在太阳房间的时间已经过去了。
我们现在去星星房间吧……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Ah, Beeryu must have
given you his riddle to
solve. Well, you'll need
to go back to town in order
to figure out the answer, so
let me send you there now~
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
啊，比尔尤一定给了你谜题去解。
嗯，你需要回城镇去找出答案，
所以我现在送你去那里~

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hm? Beeryu is expecting
you in the Moon Room. Let
me send you there right now...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯？比尔尤在月亮房间等你。
让我现在送你去那里……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hm. I cannot blame
you if you enjoy the
Room of the Sun this
much, but now is the time
for you to be in the Star
Room. I'll send you there...
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯。如果你这么喜欢太阳房间，
我不能怪你，但现在是你该去
星星房间的时候了。我送你去那里……

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Hm. I cannot blame
you if you enjoy the
Room of the Sun this
much, but you have very
important task to complete
now. Let me send you to town.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
嗯。如果你这么喜欢太阳房间，
我不能怪你，但你现在有非常重要的任务要完成。
让我送你回城镇。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
While you're here,
I ask that you don't
interfere with anyone
that may be taking the
job change test. So, would
you like to return to town?
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
当你在这里时，
我请求你不要干扰任何可能正在进行
转职测试的人。那么，你想回城镇吗？

scripts.text: Return to Payon
scripts.translation: 返回斐扬

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Daru]
I see. Let me
guide you back
to Payon, then.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
我明白了。让我
引导你回斐扬吧。

scripts.text:
[Daru]
Please take your
time and enjoy the
splendor of the Sun
while you are here.
scripts.translation:
[达鲁]
请慢慢来，享受这里的
太阳辉煌。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Welcome to the Moon Room.
I am Beeryu, your guide in
this sanctum. I shall ask you a
series of questions, so please
think carefully before giving
me your honest answer.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
欢迎来到月亮房间。
我是比尔尤，这个圣所的向导。
我将问你一系列问题，所以在给出
诚实的回答之前请仔细思考。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Which Moon do we need
and want most? Think of
the different shades of the
moon, and how it changes
on certain nights.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
我们最需要和想要哪种月亮？
想想月亮的不同色调，
以及它在某些夜晚的变化。

scripts.text: Red Moon
scripts.translation: 红月

scripts.text: Blue Moon
scripts.translation: 蓝月

scripts.text: Gold Moon
scripts.translation: 金月

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The Red Moon...?
It's a fearsome sight,
usually likened to drenching the sky with the color of blood.
The Red Moon stirs dark feelings that we shouldn't fully embrace...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
红月……？
那是可怕的景象，
通常被比喻为用血色染遍天空。
红月激起我们不应完全拥抱的黑暗情感……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The Blue Moon...?
Ah, yes. It's a calm and
gentle moon whose soft
light helps you think clearly.
It's a moon of peaceful rest...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
蓝月……？
啊，是的。那是一轮平静温柔的月亮，
其柔和的光芒帮助你清晰思考。
那是一轮和平休息的月亮……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The Gold Moon...?
Ah, that is a moon of
affluence and wealth. Now,
to aspire to attain prosperity
is natural, and to fulfill your
aspirations is life's pinnacle.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
金月……？
啊，那是富裕和财富的月亮。
渴望繁荣是自然的，实现愿望是人生的巅峰。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Hmm...?
Do you not have an
opinion of the Moon?
You should be confident
and tell me which shade
of the moon that you like...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
嗯……？
你对月亮没有看法吗？
你应该自信地告诉我你喜欢哪种色调的月亮……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Now, if the shadows
of the Moon were to
lend you their power,
to what end would you
use the power of the
Lunar cosmos?
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
现在，如果月亮的阴影借给你力量，
你会为了什么目的使用月亮宇宙的力量？

scripts.text: Justice
scripts.translation: 正义

scripts.text: Self Practice
scripts.translation: 自我修行

scripts.text: Preservation of Nature
scripts.translation: 保护自然

scripts.text: Revenge
scripts.translation: <黑暗搜集者>复仇

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Yes. Justice is always an
end that is worth fighting
for. Just remember that
both power and compassion
are required to enact the
truest form of justice.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
是的。正义总是值得为之奋斗的目标。
只要记住，实施最真实的正义需要力量和同情心。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Self training?
That is an acceptable
answer. However, you must
never forget your reasons
for attaining mastery of the
self, else you lose your way.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
自我训练？
那是一个可以接受的答案。
然而，你永远不要忘记掌握自我的原因，
否则你会迷失方向。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The preservation of
nature is the responsiblity
of every living human. However,
I was expecting a different
answer in terms of Taekwon
Mastery as a martial art...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
保护自然是每个活着的人的责任。
然而，就作为一种武术的跆拳道大师而言，
我期待一个不同的答案……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Sometimes, revenge may
seem to be best course of
action, especially if it is
carried out in the interest
of justice. However, revenge
by itself is usually ignoble.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
有时，复仇似乎是最佳行动方案，
特别是如果是为了正义的利益。
然而，复仇本身通常是不光彩的。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Ask yourself this:
what will you do after
you achieve your revenge?
When you let your rage burn
away at you, you inflict the
most harm to yourself...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
问问你自己：
复仇之后你会做什么？
当愤怒燃烧你时，你对自己造成的伤害最大……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Now, listen carefully
to the lyrics of this
song. I'm sure Daru has
sang this to you already...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
现在，仔细听这首歌的歌词。
我敢肯定达鲁已经给你唱过了……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
''^4D4DFFThe Sun shines on even days.
The Moon gleams on odd days.
The Stars sparkle on every
fifth day without fail.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
''^4D4DFF双日太阳照。
单日月亮耀。
每五日星辰闪，
从不缺席。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
''^4D4DFFA desert is a Solar place,
its sands kissed by the Sun.
A marsh is a Lunar place,
its wolves driven by the Moon.
A deep cave is a Stellar place, its knights enchanted by Stars.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
''^4D4DFF沙漠是太阳之地，
沙粒被太阳亲吻。
沼泽是月亮之地，
狼群被月亮驱使。
深洞是星星之地，骑士被星星迷住。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
According to these
lyrics, which is of
the following most
strongly evokes the
light of the moon?
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
根据这些歌词，
以下哪项最能唤起
月亮的光芒？

scripts.text: 2nd, Marsh, Dark Knights
scripts.translation: 第2天，沼泽，黑暗骑士

scripts.text: 4th, the Desert, the Sand
scripts.translation: 第4天，沙漠，沙子

scripts.text: 10th, Deep Cave, Dark Knight
scripts.translation: 第10天，深洞，黑暗骑士

scripts.text: 5th, Marsh, Wolves
scripts.translation: 第5天，沼泽，狼

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Well, I've asked the
questions I wanted to set
before you. You must learn
the bond between the moonlight
with the shadows of the moon.
Then, you will become a master.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
好吧，我问了我想问的问题。
你必须学习月光与月亮阴影之间的联系。
然后，你将成为大师。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Well, I've asked the
questions I wanted to set
before you. You must learn
to be as patient and gentle
as the moon's soft glow.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
好吧，我问了我想问的问题。
你必须学会像月亮柔和的光辉一样耐心和温柔。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The soft moonlight 
illuminates the darkest night.
The shadows of the moon balance
the Sun's glorious brightness.
Wisdom to power, coolness to
rage. Contemplate on this...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
柔和的月光照亮最黑暗的夜晚。
月亮的阴影平衡太阳的光荣明亮。
智慧对抗力量，冷静对抗愤怒。
沉思这一点……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
I have faith that you will soon
become a great Taekwon Master.
Now, the time has come for you
to enter the Star Room. Come,
follow me this way...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
我相信你很快就会成为一名伟大的跆拳道大师。
现在，是你进入星星房间的时候了。来，跟我这边走……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Please think about
this seriously. A true
Taekwon Master can
display calmness of mind
in all situations, no matter
what the stakes may be.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
请认真考虑这一点。
真正的跆拳道大师可以在任何情况下保持冷静，
无论赌注有多大。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Now, I want you to
take this chance to
practice achieving the
Lunar mindset. Be calm,
quiet your thoughts and
settle your active mind...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
现在，我希望你利用这个机会练习达到
月亮的心态。保持冷静，平息思绪，
安定活跃的心灵……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
For now, I will send
you out into Payon. Go out
and learn the ^4D4DFFtrue meaning
of patience^000000. Then, when you're
ready, please talk to Moogang
so that he can send you to me.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
目前，我会送你出去到斐扬。
出去学习^4D4DFF耐心的真谛^000000。
然后，当你准备好时，请与穆刚交谈，
让他送你到我这里。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Hm. You must first pass
testing the Room of the Sun
before you can be tested here
in the Moon Room. Let me send
you to where you must go...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
嗯。你必须先通过太阳房间的测试，
才能在月亮房间接受测试。
让我送你去你必须去的地方……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
How are you still here?
The light of the full moon
brings comfort, but you must
move on if you wish to become
a Taekwon Master. Come, I shall
guide you to the Star Room.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
你怎么还在这里？
满月的光芒带来安慰，
但如果你想成为跆拳道大师，就必须前进。
来，我将引导你去星星房间。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
I want you to bring me
proof that you understand
the nature of patience that
is associated with the moon.
You cannot become a Taekwon
Master without this attitude...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
我想你给我带来证明，
表明你理解与月亮相关的耐心本质。
没有这种态度，你就不能成为跆拳道大师……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
The proof I want you to
show me is concrete and
indisputable. Please think
about what it might be. Now,
I shall send you back to town...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
我要你给我看的证明是具体且无可争议的。
请想想那可能是什么。现在，
我将送你回城镇……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Ah, you've finally
returned. I can see in
the way that you carry
yourself that your resolve
has been strengthened. Good.
I hope you now know patience...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
啊，你终于回来了。
从你的举止中我可以看到你的决心加强了。
很好。我希望你现在知道了耐心……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Patience and resolve are
necessary to live life without
any regrets. You must believe
in yourself while being both
considerate and understanding
of others in cosmic harmony.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
耐心和决心对于无悔地生活是必要的。
你必须在宇宙和谐中相信自己，
同时体谅和理解他人。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Learn to control your
power through spiritual
training. Learn how to have
pride without hubris. You're
ready for the Star Room, so
I'll send you to Cheehee now.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
通过精神训练学习控制你的力量。
学习如何拥有骄傲而不傲慢。
你准备好去星星房间了，所以我现在送你去奇希那里。

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
You should be
receiving Cheehee's
tutelage in the Star Room
now. Come, let me guide you
there. I hope to see you as
a Taekwon Master soon...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
你现在应该在星星房间接受奇希的指导。
来，让我引导你去那里。
希望很快能看到你成为跆拳道大师……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Why are you still here?
You have something much
more important to do, so
let me send you back to town...
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
你为什么还在这里？
你有更重要的事情要做，
所以让我送你回城镇……

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Try not to bother the
Taekwon Boys and Girls
from completing their job
change test while you're here.
Ah, and let me know when
you want to return to Payon.
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
尽量不要打扰这里的
跆拳小子和少女完成他们的转职测试。
啊，当你想回斐扬时告诉我。

scripts.text: Return to Payon
scripts.translation: 返回斐扬

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Beeryu]
Be safe!
scripts.translation:
[比尔尤]
保重！

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Don't you think stars
are so beautiful? They're
like a pretty girl's teardrops
shed on a background of 
pitch black night sky...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
你不觉得星星很美吗？
它们就像漂亮女孩的眼泪，
洒在漆黑的夜空背景上……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
The test I have for
you is simple. Just
bring me the items on
this earth that come from
the stars. Bring me a piece of a star and the sand of a star...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
我给你的测试很简单。
只要给我带来地球上来自星星的物品。
给我带来一块星星碎片和星星之沙……

scripts.text:
^3355FFCheehee stands mesmerized,
staring at the sky as if she were counting each and every single
shining star in the heavens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF奇希着迷地站着，
凝视着天空，仿佛在数着天上每一颗
闪耀的星星。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Oh? You've brought exactly
what I've asked you to bring.
Did you know that the spirit
of the stars is used to enhance
the armors and weapons that
all adventurers use in battle?
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
哦？你带来了 exactly 我要求的东西。
你知道星星的精神被用来增强
所有冒险者在战斗中使用的盔甲和武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Stars are linked to the
ideas of wishes, dreams,
hopes, magic and romance.
Occasionally, the stars can
be saddening, but it's a very
sweet kind of sadness...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
星星与愿望、梦想、
希望、魔法和浪漫的概念相连。
偶尔，星星可能会令人伤感，
但那是一种非常甜蜜的伤感……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
The pieces of the stars...
The sand of the stars. If you
didn't bring them with you, then you won't find them here. You'll
have to go out and find them out there before bringing them to me.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
星星的碎片……
星星之沙。如果你没带它们来，
那你在这里也找不到它们。
你得出去找到它们，然后带给我。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Have you given any thought
to the idea of feeling sadness
from the stars? Perhaps this
song will help you better
understand, though I know
you've already heard it...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
你有没有想过从星星那里感受悲伤的想法？
也许这首歌能帮助你更好地理解，
虽然我知道你已经听过了……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
''^4D4DFFThe Sun shines on even days.
The Moon gleams on odd days.
The Stars sparkle on every
fifth day without fail.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
''^4D4DFF双日太阳照。
单日月亮耀。
每五日星辰闪，
从不缺席。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
''^4D4DFFA desert is a Solar place,
its sands kissed by the Sun.
A marsh is a Lunar place,
its wolves driven by the Moon.
A deep cave is a Stellar place, its knights enchanted by Stars.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
''^4D4DFF沙漠是太阳之地，
沙粒被太阳亲吻。
沼泽是月亮之地，
狼群被月亮驱使。
深洞是星星之地，骑士被星星迷住。^000000''

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Now...
Which of the following
groups shines brightest
with starlight?
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
现在……
以下哪一组
星光最耀眼？

scripts.text: 5th day, Deep Cave, Sand
scripts.translation: 第5天，深洞，沙子

scripts.text: 10th day, Desert, Sand
scripts.translation: 第10天，沙漠，沙子

scripts.text: 25th day, Deep Cave, Knights
scripts.translation: 第25天，深洞，骑士

scripts.text: 10th day, Desert, Knights
scripts.translation: 第10天，沙漠，骑士

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
You're right. The combination
of the 25th day, a multiple of
the number 5, and the Knights
stationed in Deep Caves shines
brightest with starlight.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
你说得对。第25天（5的倍数）与驻扎在深洞的骑士的组合，
星光最耀眼。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
If you can understand
the lyrics of this song,
you should understand the
essense of being a Taekwon
Master. Remember that light
comes in different shades...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
如果你能理解这首歌的歌词，
你就应该理解成为跆拳道大师的精髓。
记住，光有不同的色调……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
The glory of the sun, the
gentle moonlight, and the
melancholic twinkling of the
stars are unique from each
other. Please enjoy the starlight in this room as long as you like.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
太阳的荣耀，温柔的月光，
以及星星忧郁的闪烁彼此独特。
请随意在这个房间里享受星光。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
When you are ready,
please go speak to
Moogang again. I will
let him know that you
completed our testing.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
当你准备好时，
请再去和穆刚谈谈。
我会告诉他你完成了我们的测试。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Hmm...
You must learn more
about the nature of the
Stars. You must understand
the cosmos if you are to
become a Taekwon Master.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
嗯……
你必须更多地了解星星的本质。
如果你想成为跆拳道大师，
你必须理解宇宙。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
If you can understand
the lyrics of this song,
you should understand the
essense of being a Taekwon
Master. Remember that light
comes in different shades...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
如果你能理解这首歌的歌词，
你就应该理解成为跆拳道大师的精髓。
记住，光有不同的色调……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
The glory of the sun, the
gentle moonlight, and the
melancholic twinkling of the
stars are unique from each
other. Please enjoy the starlight in this room as long as you like.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
太阳的荣耀，温柔的月光，
以及星星忧郁的闪烁彼此独特。
请随意在这个房间里享受星光。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
When you are ready,
please go speak to
Moogang again. I will
let him know that you
completed our testing.
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
当你准备好时，
请再去和穆刚谈谈。
我会告诉他你完成了我们的测试。

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Do you wish to
leave the Star Room?
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
你想离开星星房间吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Then, I shall guide
you to Payon, the closest
town. Farewell for now...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
那么，我将引导你去最近的城镇斐扬。
暂时告别……

scripts.text:
[Cheehee]
Please, take your
time and enjoy the
starlight in this room...
scripts.translation:
[奇希]
请慢慢来，享受这个房间里的
星光……

scripts.text:

are beautiful, aren't
they? Would you like
to return to Payon now?
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
